paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 µeV
notes: Exclusion limit from null experimental result on KSVZ axion dark matter searches using multi-cell cavity haloscope in 12T magnetic field. Paper explicitly states g_aγγ ≥ 0.93 × g_aγγ^KSVZ at 90% CL across entire 21.86-22.00 µeV mass range. Assumes local axion dark matter halo density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ (standard cosmological value). Total systematic uncertainty 4.7% (noise temperature 8.1%, SNR efficiency, Smith circle fitting 1.7%, loaded Q 1.3%). TE313 cavity mode identified as source of slight modulation between 21.90-21.92 µeV. Data collected July-November 2023 over 82 days with 91.3% DAQ efficiency.
